summary: Delete an EDA credential via More Actions > Delete credential and confirm; it must not be linked to rulebook activations or used by an event stream, otherwise a warning blocks deletion. Several can be deleted at once via checkboxes and Delete selected credentials.
questions: How do I delete a credential in Event-Driven Ansible?
Why can't I delete my EDA credential?
Credential cannot be deleted because it is used by an event stream
Can I delete multiple EDA credentials at once?
